title: Subgroup Matrix — Closing the Gap
idea: 面向国际开发者的英文技术短片。以 on-device inference 的矩阵乘瓶颈开场，讲述各家 GPU 的矩阵硬件、Vulkan / Metal 的支持与 D3D12 LinAlg preview，再把主角转为让预览功能变得可用的工程工作：已合入 Dawn 的五项修复，以及待上游化的 ORT 实验集成。最后以两个独立、上下文完整的 AMD 实测结果收束。通过软件栈真正接通硬件，是全片的转折和主题。

brief.audience: International GPU, WebGPU and on-device inference developers
brief.story: A language model wants to answer on the device. Matrix computation is a major obstacle in prefill. Hardware and APIs offer a route, but preview availability is not application readiness. We close gaps in Dawn and experiment in ORT, then measure the benefit and its limits on AMD.
brief.materials: Preserved source demo and evaluation report. Exact code-rendered numbers. Conceptual Nano Banana art only for device establishing shots. No invented GPU photographs, no simulated live benchmark.

bible.logline: 矩阵硬件已经存在；我们正在补齐从 preview API 到真实端侧推理之间的软件链路，并用 AMD 数据验证价值与边界。
bible.arc: 00:00–00:26 desire and bottleneck; 00:26–01:06 hardware and API opportunity; 01:06–01:46 the engineering turn and contributions; 01:46–02:36 measured payoff and limits; 02:36–02:48 return to the device.
bible.visualRules: Override the fallback midnight palette in every authored composition: ink #0A1016, porcelain #F1EEE7, jade #64D8CB, slate #8C9BA8, preview amber #DFA861, regression coral #D4837C. Do not use the previous lime palette. Inter 400/500/600/700. One focal action at a time; no webpage cards, generic star fields, slide carousel, glitch effects or persistent zoom. All claims and numbers are native text, never AI-painted. Native and ORT evidence have distinct hardware slates. Reserve bottom 17% for captions/evidence.
bible.continuity: A small warm-white inference request travels left to right, becomes matrix tiles, and later crosses the API/compiler/runtime bridge. Jade marks executed matrix work, amber marks the preview boundary, slate marks the baseline. Opening and ending show the same unbranded laptop, charcoal desk and soft side light. Shape-match the prompt cursor, matrix tile, capability gate and final response cursor. Abstract diagrams are conceptual, never literal chip layouts.
bible.cameraGrammar: Use an establishing push to find the request, a tracking move to follow computation, a pull to reveal the software bridge, and locked evidence shots. Camera movement must end before numerical reading. Smooth acceleration and deceleration; maximum about 8% scale change on readable text. Do not zoom all shots. Shared left-to-right motion is the transition, not an added wipe on every cut.
bible.soundGrammar: A restrained two-note motif begins incomplete, gains a bass foundation as the bridge connects, and resolves at the closing response. Early sparse felt-like keys and warm pad; restrained low pulse through engineering; remove percussion ahead of the first benchmark; keep both benchmarks calm. Last chord decays into room tone. See SOUND-DESIGN.md; this is authored direction, not a claim of generated or reviewed sound.

scenes.title: Intelligence. Right here.
scenes.body: A model. Your device. A response worth waiting for.
scenes.narration: What if a powerful language model could respond right here, on your device? No server round trip. The challenge is making local inference fast enough.
scenes.note: Conceptual illustration · no live inference is shown
scenes.imagePrompt: Unbranded thin laptop on a charcoal desk, in a dark quiet room, three-quarter side view. Screen a blank warm-white luminous rectangle with no text, UI, symbols, numbers or logo. Restrained jade rim light and soft porcelain key light; tangible matte materials, photographic restraint, no glowing cyberpunk circuits. Device in right half, generous dark space to the left. Same laptop and light must return in the last shot. Conceptual device, not a picture of the tested GPU.

direction.purpose: 前三秒让观众看见本地设备上的一个请求，先建立应用动机，再提出速度问题。
direction.framing: 侧面中景，电脑在右侧；左侧保留短标题。屏幕内容后期用代码精确叠加。
direction.staging: 0–3 秒光标和一句短请求出现；3–8 秒镜头靠近屏幕；8–12 秒请求变成一颗暖白数据点。
direction.action: 缓慢推进约 6%，把注意力从设备带到等待中的请求；数据点向右离开画面，进入下一镜。
direction.transitionIntent: 屏幕光标与下一镜矩阵单元格做形状匹配；不使用通用转场模板。
direction.sound: 留 0.7 秒室内底噪再进旁白；两颗干净琴音提出未完成的动机，不立即加鼓。

scenes.title: The matrix bottleneck
scenes.body: Attention projections + feed-forward layers → matrix multiplication
scenes.narration: In transformer prefill, attention projections and feed-forward layers demand large matrix multiplications. Multiply, accumulate, repeat. Executing these compute-heavy operations efficiently is one of the keys to faster responses.
scenes.note: Conceptual animation · prefill focus; decode can be memory-bound

direction.purpose: 把等待落实为可理解的矩阵运算，同时限定在 prefill，避免把所有推理都说成算力瓶颈。
direction.framing: 从请求数据点切入矩阵近景，再横移到输出。A[M,K]、B[K,N]、C[M,N] 保持清楚。
direction.staging: 0–4 秒 token 队列展开成两个矩阵；4–9 秒两束行列片段相交、积累；9–14 秒出现 C′ = A×B+C 与等待中的输出。
direction.action: 镜头跟随一块数据从左到右；多个计算单元形成重复工作量，最后合成一个协作 tile。示意格数不是硬件支持形状。
direction.transitionIntent: tile 的轮廓连续变成下一镜的矩阵执行单元。
direction.sound: 脉冲渐入；multiply、accumulate 两处轻触音，禁止每个格子都发声。

scenes.title: Hardware moved first
scenes.body: NVIDIA Tensor Cores · AMD matrix instructions · Intel XMX · Apple matrix-capable GPUs
scenes.narration: GPU vendors have built for this workload: NVIDIA Tensor Cores, AMD matrix instructions, Intel XMX, and Apple's matrix-capable GPUs. The common idea: accelerate whole matrix operations.
scenes.note: Hardware families differ · API and datatype support remain device-dependent

direction.purpose: 建立跨厂商趋势：硬件端早已迈出一步，为下一镜的软件缺口铺垫。
direction.framing: 一个执行 tile 的特写拉开，四条独立硬件轨道依次进入，不做四张宣传卡。
direction.staging: 0–3 秒 tile 亮起；3–10 秒四家名字和各自机制按旁白依次出现；10–14 秒共同汇向矩阵操作。
direction.action: 拉镜揭示共同能力，厂商名称位置稳定。AMD 可标 MFMA / WMMA；Apple 不沿用旧 demo 存疑的最早年份。
direction.transitionIntent: 四条硬件轨道向左后景退，前景显露 API 路线。
direction.sound: 低频基底加入，四家不配四声品牌提示音；音乐以持续性表达多年演进。

scenes.title: The APIs follow
scenes.body: Vulkan: cooperative matrices · Metal: SIMD-group matrices · D3D12: a longer path
scenes.narration: Vulkan exposes cooperative matrices. Metal has SIMD-group matrices. Direct3D's path took longer, including an earlier experiment that was withdrawn. For this workload, the software bridge was still catching up.
scenes.note: API history · not an API performance ranking

direction.purpose: 解释为什么硬件能力不会自然变成应用能力：Vulkan 和 Metal 已有通路，D3D 路线走得更久。
direction.framing: 同一空间的三条 API 桥梁；Vulkan、Metal 为已连通实线，D3D12 先留出一段间隙。
direction.staging: 0–5 秒依次跟随 Vulkan、Metal 的数据；5–9 秒平移至 D3D12；9–14 秒旧 WaveMatrix 实验的虚线淡出。
direction.action: 以同一个数据点尝试过桥，差异是桥的状态，不用厂商排名条。长镜头末段锁定缺口。
direction.transitionIntent: 让 D3D12 缺口留在原位，下一镜 LinAlg 从该位置接入。
direction.sound: 节拍稍收，D3D12 缺口处留半拍，不用故障报警。

scenes.title: LinAlg enters the picture
scenes.narration: Now, Direct3D twelve has LinAlg in Shader Model six point ten, still in preview. The bridge is taking shape. But an API announcement is only the beginning.
scenes.note: Microsoft Agility release page checked 2026-10-05 · evaluated SDK 1.721.3 preview

direction.purpose: 把 LinAlg 到来作为机会，同时保留 preview 身份，为工程转折做准备。
direction.framing: 缺口中央出现 LinAlg，一条琥珀色桥接上；PREVIEW 标签持续可读。
direction.staging: 0–4 秒桥结构成形；4–8 秒 LinAlg / SM 6.10 锁定；8–12 秒镜头轻拉，桥外露出尚未接通的应用端。
direction.action: 图形主体连接完成，镜头却揭示系统边界之外还有路径，从而自然引出转折。
direction.transitionIntent: 拉出的空隙变成下一镜待验证的三个检查点。
direction.sound: 和声变明但暂不解决；only the beginning 后留一个自然呼吸。

scenes.title: Available. But usable?
scenes.body: Reach the hardware. Select valid configurations. Finish reliably.
scenes.narration: Can applications actually reach the hardware, select valid configurations, and finish reliably? That's where our work begins.
scenes.note: Illustrative checkpoints from the evaluation; not a live test run

direction.purpose: 全片转折：主角从 API 发布变为我们的验证、修复与集成工作。
direction.framing: 宽景中的路径停在三个闸口，主体是被挡住的数据点，不是三个密集文本框。
direction.staging: 0–2 秒请求停下；2–6 秒 capability、compilation、lifetime 三处浮现；6–10 秒镜头停住，让问题和回答落地。
direction.action: 通过主体停止产生张力；不靠快速剪辑假装复杂。最后一道青玉色修复线开始生长。

scenes.title: Making Dawn more reliable
scenes.narration: In Dawn, a WebGPU implementation, we contributed five fixes: accurate capability checks, explicit subgroup-size validation, correct matrix-load compilation, and safe runtime teardown. Those changes are merged upstream.

direction.purpose: 用修复带来的行为改变解释贡献，而不把镜头变为提交列表。
direction.framing: 跟随数据走过 Dawn / Tint 的三段路径；将五项修复归为能力与校验、编译、生命周期三个可读成果。
direction.staging: 0–5 秒无效配置被正确挡住；5–10 秒合法 tile 进入编译路径；10–13 秒运行结束有序释放；13–16 秒停稳在 5 fixes / MERGED。
direction.action: 轨道由琥珀变青玉只表示验证通过。实际五个 CL 在证据带列出，不滚动代码或伪造 CI。
direction.transitionIntent: 通过 Dawn 的数据点进入下一镜 ORT 层。
direction.sound: 低音和精简打击乐恢复推进；每个成果只用一次低音量质感触点，不加胜利音效。

scenes.title: 4.13× at the kernel
scenes.body: MLP up · 12.41 → 51.27 TFLOP/s · versus FP16 FMA
scenes.narration: First, the kernel. On Radeon RX ninety seventy XT, native Direct3D twelve matrix multiplication reaches four point one three times the FP sixteen F M A baseline on the MLP up projection.
scenes.note: 2026-09-21 · M×K×N 512×8192×3072 · f16×f16→f32 · GPU dispatch timestamps · recorded results

direction.purpose: 先证明计算内核价值；这不是 ORT 或整部模型的 4.13×。
direction.framing: 先用 RX 9070 XT / NATIVE D3D12 身份板明确设备，再显示同轴两根性能条；完全锁机位。
direction.staging: 0–3 秒实际 demo 中 MLP up 选择状态的裁切（标 Recorded results）；3–8 秒重绘同一组数据；8–16 秒留足 8 秒读数。
direction.action: 基线 12.41、矩阵 51.27 同为 TFLOP/s，横轴从 0 起。4.13× 只在条长到位后出现。不能把 4.13 写成全模型加速。
direction.transitionIntent: 硬切到另一张硬件身份板，清楚宣告下一组是另一 GPU、另一层级。
direction.sound: First, the kernel 前短暂降低配乐；数据落定用极轻的单次触点，不给每根条配 whoosh。

scenes.title: +82% prefill throughput
scenes.narration: Then, the model. On Radeon RX seventy-nine hundred XTX, Phi four mini prefill rises from about twenty-eight hundred to over five thousand tokens per second. That's eighty-two percent higher throughput for a five-hundred-twelve-token prompt.
scenes.note: D3D12 WebGPU EP · graph capture ON · DP4A vs subgroup matrix · report snapshot 2026-08-31 · experimental build

direction.purpose: 把 kernel 价值接回实际模型。选用报告同一次四臂复测的 D3D12 两臂，不拼接其他实验数据。
direction.framing: RX 7900 XTX / ORT 身份板保持可见；主视觉是 PREFILL +82%，次级才是两臂精确 tok/s。
direction.staging: 0–3 秒设备与模型先出现；3–7 秒 2,781、5,056 两根同轴条到位；7–18 秒锁定。512-token prompt 全程留在数字附近。
direction.action: 由短条伸展到长条只做一次，不反复计数。显示 DP4A baseline 与 subgroup matrix 标签；模型 INT4 权重，不误标为原生 FP16 FMA。
direction.transitionIntent: 镜头继续停稳，结果条下方展开完整生成时间线，进入边界说明。
direction.sound: 旁白最清楚的一段，维持低密度和声；不加新的打击乐，不以音乐淹没数字。

scenes.title: The workload still matters
scenes.eyebrow: 11 / PREFILL IS ONLY PART OF THE RUN
scenes.narration: That is a prefill gain. Decode barely changes, and the complete generation run is about eight percent shorter. A shorter, one-hundred-twenty-eight-token prompt regresses. Choosing the right workload still matters.
scenes.note: RX 7900 XTX · same D3D12 four-arm rerun · full run: 512 input + 128 generated tokens · not universal gains

direction.purpose: 让结论可信：解释局部提速为何只缩短约 8% 总时间，并主动保留短提示词退步。
direction.framing: 一条 prefill + decode 时间轴，prefill 段缩短、decode 基本不变。不得把两段按吞吐量比例伪造为精确时长。
direction.staging: 0–7 秒以概念比例说明局部/整体，并用精确总时间标签 1,116 → 1,025 ms；7–11 秒保持；11–16 秒短 prompt 的 0.93× 小幅回落成为最后一拍。
direction.action: 总时间使用精确测量，分段图明确为概念示意。128-token 回归仅指 prefill，不能与 128 个生成 token 混淆。
direction.transitionIntent: 时间线汇回开场同一设备，完成从用户等待到工程收益的闭环。
direction.sound: 配乐变薄，给 caveat 同样清晰的空间；不以负面警报夸大 7% 回归。

scenes.title: Closing the gap.
scenes.body: Subgroup Matrix · From capability to usable inference
scenes.narration: From matrix hardware to usable inference: the missing link is the software stack. We're helping close that gap, one validated path at a time.
scenes.note: Conceptual closing · full evidence and source snapshots accompany this film
scenes.imagePrompt: Return to the SAME unbranded laptop, charcoal desk, three-quarter side view and lighting as the opening reference. Slightly wider framing. Soft warm-white screen without any text, UI or logo; restrained jade rim light, tangible matte materials, quiet earned optimism. Generous dark negative space at left for a code-rendered final title. No celebratory rays, no futuristic hologram, no invented branded hardware.

direction.purpose: 回到开场的本地请求，以已验证的软件链路回答它，留下工程价值而非夸张口号。
